title: Cognitive Task Type
description: Observable cognitive task-verb axis, orthogonal to Bloom level. Where bloom_level captures the cognitive process tier (remember/understand/apply/analyze/evaluate/create) and question_type captures the assessment instrument (multiple_choice/short_answer/...), cognitive_task_type captures WHAT the learner is asked to do: classify a thing, compute a value, debug a failure, critique a position. Two apply-tier multiple-choice questions can differ entirely on this axis (compute vs. debug vs. classify); without it that orthogonal signal is lost. Authored 2026-05 in response to GPT feedback (item 5, plans/gptfeedback12may.txt) requesting observable task-type tagging as a separate axis.
$comment: 15-value enum lifted from the bloom_verbs.json canonical 60-verb list (one pedagogically-distinct task verb per cell, deliberately spread across all 6 Bloom buckets so the axis is genuinely orthogonal to level). `debug` is new — not in bloom_verbs.json — seeded because GPT feedback explicitly called it out as the dominant CS task verb. Per REC-VOC-01.
